name: com.ohze.gameup.core
description:
Core framework for Unity game development including Singleton, EventBus, FSM, Object Pool, UI Manager, Audio, Save/Load, and more. Git UPM flow: install DOTween first (Assets/Plugins/Demigiant + DOTween.Modules.asmdef), then enable define DOTween__DEPENDENCIES_INSTALLED from GameUp/Project/GameUpCore Installer. Cursor: menu GameUp/Project/Install Cursor IDE rules adds com.boxqkrtm.ide.cursor via PackageManager Client.Add (Git URL), copies .mdc rules, .cursorrules, .cursorignore from Documentation~; first editor load still auto-copies .mdc only if missing. Optional manifest line for IDE: "com.boxqkrtm.ide.cursor": "https://github.com/boxqkrtm/com.unity.ide.cursor.git". Repo: https://github.com/ohze/gameup-unity-template 

DuyLV 2026
